name: Assignment Submission Notification (Instructor)
description: Notification sent to instructors when a student submits an assignment
subject: New Assignment Submission: {assignment_title}
body_html:
📝 New Assignment Submission

Dear {instructor_first_name},

A student has submitted an assignment for your review.

Assignment Details:

  • Module: {module_code} - {module_name}
  • Assignment: {assignment_title}
  • Student: {student_name} ({student_id})
  • Submission Version: {version_number}
  • Status: {submission_status}{late_text}
  • Submission Time: {submission_time}

Please review the submission in the Assignment Grading System.

Best regards,
Assignment Management System
